comparison.objective: Classify cartons by liftability, shelve light ones, and hand off the heavy one, not commission an absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Test-lifts, detects payload limits, shelves, and slides cartons without dropping them; no fine tool alignment or rotary tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Two light cartons shelved and the test-lifted heavy carton upright on the handoff mat versus two controlled impacts.
comparison.reason: It tests load inference and material handling, not adjustment of a mechanical response.
